persona: Maria, a home cook with zero coding experience
plain_request: I want a website where my whole family can post our recipes, search them by ingredient, and leave comments. I don't know anything about computers — please just make it good.
title: family recipe-sharing web app
critical_rationale: A non-technical user never asks for accessibility; a world-class delivery enforces WCAG 2.2 (w3c namespace) anyway — alt text, focus indicators, correct ARIA.
acceptance_criteria: A visitor can post a recipe with a title, ingredient list, and steps
A visitor can search recipes by name or by ingredient
Every image has descriptive alt text and the whole site is usable with only a keyboard
Pages feel fast on a phone (Largest Contentful Paint under 2.5 seconds)
